texts.controlled: The input and output power readings from the fifth amplifier out of S02 towards S18 have been flat since about 14:12 while the readings around them move. Why?
texts.free: Ticket: oms.S02-S18.amp4 (amp on OMS S02–S18, 5th site from S02, not a booster) — monitoring shows its reported input and output power have been unchanged since ~14:10 today while neighbouring readings vary. Can someone check whether that amp's power readings are actually updating? Not sure of the cause.
